summary: Frontend-only verification of the new always-visible composer editor (SectionEditor) on /generate. Verified: editor renders in DEFAULT IDLE state below Accent colour with Layers (4 rows + up/down), draggable canvas (4 blocks), full style inspector, GENERATED CODE preview and working 'Download .jsx' (real download, filename Hero.jsx). Live two-way sync confirmed between composer editor <-> Live Preview iframe <-> composer code preview <-> pipeline Done-state Design tab <-> pipeline Code tab. Dual-mount isolation verified (composer-* prefixed testids vs unprefixed pipeline testids, no collisions). pipeline-code-download-button downloads Hero.jsx. Regression smoke passed: 5 dev states, Generate animation, accent presets updating CTA bg inside composer canvas, dropzone 'max 8MB', Home/Studio/Preview nav, /preview 03 Custom reflecting composer edits from localStorage, single-column stacked layout with zero horizontal overflow at both 1920px and 390px. Zero console errors across all runs.

issues: Layer row labels ('Supporting copy') wrap/clip inside the flex 1 1 130px chips at mobile width - cosmetic only, rows remain clickable

action_items: OPTIONAL/minor: data-testid="status-badge" appears 3x in the DOM (shared Badge in components/Shell.jsx line 13) - pre-existing, unrelated to this change, but it is the only duplicate testid on the page; consider making it unique per usage.
OPTIONAL/cosmetic: allow layer-row labels to ellipsize instead of wrapping at 390px.
critical_code_review_comments: SectionEditor.downloadCode duplicates the download helper now also present in PipelinePanel - extract a single shared util to avoid divergence (e.g. filename/mime changes).

DesignTab scope-prefix approach works, but the wrapper testid is 'composer-section-editor' while SectionEditor's outer div is 'composer-section-editor-wrap' - names are easy to confuse; both verified present and unique.
downloadCode revokes the object URL synchronously right after a.click(); it worked in Chromium but is technically racy - prefer revoking in a setTimeout/onload.
seed_data_creation: None - client-side mock state only; edits made during tests persist in localStorage (headline text left as 'CUSTOM PERSIST 8' from the last run).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 8 verified the composer-embedded SectionEditor end to end. Notes for reuse: accent control testids are accent-colour-toggle / accent-colour-input / accent-preset-<hex-without-#>; there is no accent-hex-input. The pipeline Code tab is a <textarea> so use input_value(), not inner_text(). /preview variation buttons are variation-a/-b/-c-button (labels 01/02/03) and the custom one renders inside custom-preview-iframe. Only duplicate testid in DOM is 'status-badge' (x3, from Shell.jsx Badge).
rca_of_the_issue: No defects found. Two initial test failures were test-script artifacts (wrong accent testid guess; using inner_text on a textarea), both re-verified as passing with correct selectors.
